Sun opportunity score formula: (1 - cloud_cover) × uv_factor × hour_factor
Hour factor: peaks at solar noon (1.0), drops to 0.2 at 7am/7pm
UV factor: (uv_index / 10) capped at 1.0
Cloud factor: 100% clear = 1.0, 100% cloudy = 0.2 (scattered still counts)
Composite score: threshold > 0.6 = green, 0.3–0.6 = yellow, < 0.3 = red
Best 2-hour window: highest consecutive 2 hours of score per day
Trip sun score: avg of daily scores across trip dates at destination
Rain penalty: precipitation > 0.5mm/hr = automatic score 0.0
Wind comfort adjustment: > 25mph reduces outdoor comfort
Temperature comfort band: 55–85°F scores full comfort bonus
Base IU formula: (UV_index × minutes × skin_factor × body_factor) / constant
Skin factor: Type I=2.5, II=2.0, III=1.5, IV=1.0, V=0.7, VI=0.5
Body factor: face+hands=0.15, add arms=0.3, add legs=0.5, full body=1.0
Sunscreen factor: SPF30 reduces production by 97%
Age factor: over 70 produces 75% less D3 than young adults
Season factor: winter at high latitude = reduced UV angle correction
Formula disclaimer shown in-app: estimates only, not medical advice
Formula transparency screen: tap 'i' to see inputs + formula
Compare to: one glass of milk = 100 IU (relatable reference)
Formula sourced from WHO and Holick et al. UV photobiology research
